diagnosis: The cleared sandbox environment omitted an explicit UTF-8 locale; javac reports unmappable UTF-8 bytes for US-ASCII. Separately, whole-production Cobertura instrumentation fails on Jsoup with Method code too large and times out during Mockito instrumentation. Ten completed reports bind all source coordinates and reproduce the exact triggering exception types.
decision: Preserve the original gate and all failures. A locale-only replay has a maximum14/16 ceiling if the two instrumentation failures persist and cannot clear15/16. Research a different coverage instrument before another full capacity pilot; do not exclude generated classes or use fix-modified defaults to obtain a pass.
claim_ceiling: Exposed multi-project capacity failure, not quality or superiority. No providers or new confirmation were consumed.
open_questions: Can a UTF-8-explicit on-the-fly coverage instrument handle the two structural failures without dropping production classes?
Can class-byte/source identity and the exact failure be preserved?
Would usable runtime evidence improve discrimination under identical matched comparator inputs and total execution cost?
